comparison.reason: Exclusive selector positions exclude simultaneous admissibility under one fixed mode. No end-to-end Local Hand service proof has been supplied in this study.

evidence_gap_duration.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Credited-service tag false while physical service tag true.

human_effort.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Active work duration is unmeasured.

intervention_count.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Drive starts counted by rising run-feedback edges.

resource_use.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Motor energy use is unmeasured.

restoration_delay.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Elapsed between first row and first credited-service row.

service_deficit.provenance: nominal_remote ticks 0–2. Sum of fixture flow shortfall below 5 L/s times the scan period.

restoration_delay_origin: Timestamp of first recorded row (tick 0), distinct from the three completed scans.
safety_definition: At each sample, 0 <= flow <= 10 L/s, pressure <= 90 psi, pH in range and trip clear.
service_definition: Actual flow >= 5 L/s, pressure <= 90 psi, pH in range and trip clear; establishment additionally requires a credible observed flow >= 5 L/s.
trace_scope: First three synthetic scans. Each row represents one 0.1 s interval for integration.
